comments_select.name: comments_select
comments_select.using: nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid is not null and exists (select 1 from posts p where p.id = "comments"."post_id")

comments_insert_self.name: comments_insert_self
comments_insert_self.withCheck: "comments"."author_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid and exists (select 1 from posts p where p.id = "comments"."post_id")

comments_delete.name: comments_delete
comments_delete.using: "comments"."author_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid or exists (select 1 from posts p where p.id = "comments"."post_id" and p.author_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid)

conversations_insert.name: conversations_insert
conversations_insert.withCheck: "conversations"."created_by" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid and ("conversations"."kind" = 'group' or nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid in ("conversations"."user_a", "conversations"."user_b"))

conversations_kind.name: conversations_kind
conversations_kind.value: ("conversations"."kind" = 'direct' and "conversations"."user_a" < "conversations"."user_b") or ("conversations"."kind" = 'group' and "conversations"."user_a" is null and "conversations"."user_b" is null)

conversations_title_len.name: conversations_title_len
conversations_title_len.value: "conversations"."title" is null or char_length("conversations"."title") between 1 and 60

post_hashtags_insert.name: post_hashtags_insert
post_hashtags_insert.withCheck: exists (select 1 from posts p where p.id = "post_hashtags"."post_id" and p.author_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid)

post_likes_insert_self.name: post_likes_insert_self
post_likes_insert_self.withCheck: "post_likes"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid and exists (select 1 from posts p where p.id = "post_likes"."post_id")

post_media_insert.name: post_media_insert
post_media_insert.withCheck:
exists (select 1 from posts p where p.id = "post_media"."post_id" and p.author_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid)
        and exists (select 1 from media m where m.id = "post_media"."media_id" and m.owner_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid)

posts_select.name: posts_select
posts_select.using: nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid is not null and app.can_see("posts"."author_id")

reposts_insert_self.name: reposts_insert_self
reposts_insert_self.withCheck: "reposts"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid and exists (select 1 from posts p where p.id = "reposts"."post_id")

saved_posts_owner.name: saved_posts_owner
saved_posts_owner.withCheck: "saved_posts"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid and exists (select 1 from posts p where p.id = "saved_posts"."post_id")

stories_select_active.name: stories_select_active
stories_select_active.using: nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid is not null and "stories"."expires_at" > now() and app.can_see("stories"."author_id")

stories_insert_self.name: stories_insert_self
stories_insert_self.withCheck: "stories"."author_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid and exists (select 1 from media m where m.id = "stories"."media_id" and m.owner_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid)

story_views_select.name: story_views_select
story_views_select.using: "story_views"."viewer_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid or exists (select 1 from stories s where s.id = "story_views"."story_id" and s.author_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid)
